title: Restoring Entitlement After an Amended Enrollment - Montgomery GI Bill and Chapter 35 Desk Reference
content:
**Desk reference — Education Benefits (GI Bill and Dependents' Education), Montgomery GI Bill - Active Duty (Chapter 30), Survivors' and Dependents' Educational Assistance (Chapter 35) and Montgomery GI Bill - Selected Reserve (Chapter 1606).**

**When it applies.** When a school reports a reduction of a Chapter 30, Chapter 35 or Chapter 1606 term, VA gives back the entitlement charged for the training no longer certified on the latest reduction reported on the benefit, whose term start and term end are carried on the amendment.

**Timing.** The entitlement is given back once the reduced term has ended and its enrollment is final: while the term end carried on the amendment is today or a later day, nothing is given back yet and no restoration entry is booked for that term.

| Term end carried on the amendment | Entitlement given back now |
|---|---|
| A later day than today | No — nothing yet, and no restoration entry for that term |
| Today | No — nothing yet, and no restoration entry for that term |
| Yesterday or earlier | Yes — the term has ended |

**What a restoration books.** A restoration records one restoration entry on the student's entitlement ledger (the entitlement history) for the amended certification: the days given back, the first and last day of training they cover and the reason. The days are added to the entitlement remaining on the student's education benefit, and the student sees the higher entitlement balance straight away. Nothing else on the benefit, the certification or any payment changes.

### Invocation

The representative unlocks and then calls the agent-side tool `restore_amended_entitlement_47573840`.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `enrollment_id` | The reference number of the school's term certification whose charged entitlement is given back, as shown on the student's enrollment and entitlement records | Identifier |
| `restoration_reason` | Why the entitlement is given back | Exactly one of the values below |
| `days` | The entitlement days given back | Whole number of days, positive |
| `charge_period_start` | The first day of training the restoration covers | YYYY-MM-DD, no time and no time zone |
| `charge_period_end` | The last day of training the restoration covers | YYYY-MM-DD, no time and no time zone |

Values of `restoration_reason`:
- `amended_enrollment` — the school reported a reduction or withdrawal that left days no longer certified;
- `school_closure` — the school closed during the term;
- `program_disapproval` — the student's program lost its approval during the term;
- `not_applicable` — the entry is a charge rather than a restoration; never used for a restoration.

### Receipt

On success the receipt returns `status` "restored", `entitlement_txn_id` (the reference number of the restoration entry), `enrollment_id`, `days`, `charge_period_start` and `charge_period_end` (YYYY-MM-DD), and `entitlement_days_remaining` (the whole days now remaining on the benefit). The tool defines no error receipt.
